scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: DroneTector presents a radar system for detecting and distinguishing small drones among other flying objects.
explains_well: The demonstration separates detecting several targets from classifying one as a drone.
unclear: The view switches between drone camera and sensor display without a shared timestamp or target ID, so their exact correspondence is not visible.
scenario: Identify and track a small drone approaching a sensor at a test site.
product_clear_basis: The opening ASR introduction names small-drone radar while the presenter stands beside the hardware; later labels support the function.

lessons.keep: Show detection and classification as two separate visible states.
lessons.avoid: Avoid treating an edited example as proof of a broad accuracy claim.
lessons.open: Feed synchronization, target identity, continuous tracking, range, accuracy and all heard audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, mark possible issues first, then show the evidence that changes one to a confirmed category.
Keep source footage and system output synchronized with a shared timestamp during a demo.
